## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set; second model agrees [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive >99%; InSitu <1% | Strongly favors Invasive |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / percentile 1.0 | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Invasive | Mostly supportive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 3, 7) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; concept model links it to invasive · Validated [F2]
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 3, 4, 7) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; small contribution · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Scored below typical; lack of tubules adds invasive association; caption check failed · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Scored well below typical; adds invasive association; spot check mixed · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion CI excludes 0 (+0.54 logit, 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (+0.002); not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses and normal lobules (both 0/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Blur (severity 3) hides nuclear detail, so concept scores on blurred regions may mislead.
- Regions 1, 4, 5 score ≤7% invasive per region; invasion may be focal.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 3, 7**: confirm stromal infiltration versus in-situ spread.
2. **Regions 1, 4, 5**: low per-region risk; confirm no missed invasion.
3. **Region 9**: strongest tubule score, 70% risk; check glands versus invasion.
